summary.headline: Astrological Lots and Their Significations
summary.text: Chapters 45–47 discuss stars under the Sun’s rays, the times of pivots, succedents, and cadents, and the astrological significance of lots. The lots of Fortune, Spirit, the basis of life, Nemesis, Victory, Courage, Eros, and Necessity are assigned meanings involving body, soul, reputation, travel, death, success, boldness, desire, constraint, and violence, with reference to Porphyry.
